<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Rajya Sabha elections:</strong> The Election Commission has scheduled polls for 12 Rajya Sabha seats across Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and West Bengal for October 16, with senior leaders like Ram Gopal Yadav signaling readiness to contest.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission oversight:</strong> Concerns regarding the Election Commission’s administrative role and democratic processes in West Bengal remain a focal point of national political discourse.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court rulings:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that false declarations in insurance claims justify the forfeiture of benefits and affirmed that individuals cannot face criminal charges for declining to sing all stanzas of ‘Vande Mataram’.</li>
</ul>
